messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] effect of audio playback

hi Nick,
 you could try having a period-specific detection probability parameter -- so the model should be the N-mixture model but with K=2 replicate samples, each with its own detection parameter. There should be plenty of examples of similar models in the documentation (you should set up an "observation covariate" that has value = 0 for period 1 and value = 1 for period 2).
regards
andy


 
On Thu, Dec 20, 2012 at 1:09 PM, <nic...@yahoo.com> wrote:

I'm using pcount for a bird survey where we start with an initial 5-minute silent period, and then use audio playback. I suppose if I were interested in how playback affected things I could do two different runs, one using the data from the initial 5-minute silent period, and one using the data from the playback period. But is there a more elegant way to model this - with a covariate or some other way to identify the 2 different methods?


Thanks


Nick
